question: How can I add project-specific instructions for Cursor to follow when working with my documentation?
ground_truth: You can add project-specific rules to the `.cursorrules` file in the root of your project. This file allows you to define custom instructions that Cursor will follow when working with your codebase, such as documentation writing guidelines, formatting rules, and component usage standards.
